title: The Loose Deadline
author: Casper Winterbourne
blurb: Felix Quintana, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
